title: Given Once, Not Repeated
subtitle: 指令与指挥 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 指令与指挥（历史社会与文化·领袖与政治）
meta: 主题语境：指令与指挥（历史社会与文化·领袖与政治）　|　核心词汇：command　|　正文 332 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 command 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 my great-uncle ① took command of a boat that had no engine, and he said the taking was the whole of the voyage. The ② command, meaning the order and not the asking, was given once and was not repeated; command, he said, is the only thing on a boat that is judged by how few times it is given.

Every ③ command on that boat had the same tone, and the ④ command at the end, meaning the one he kept for the rocks and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever repeated. Command, my grandmother said, is nine parts tone and one part somebody willing to be obeyed; my great-uncle said the tone is the part that carries across water.

My mother meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ a command of French was the whole of the interview, meaning the having and not the ordering. The ⑥ command, meaning the having and not any of that, is the only thing in an interview that everybody notices and nobody teaches; command, she said, is either something you give or the only word that means both an order and a having. He said the having is the part they remember.

By 1964 the ⑦ command had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the tone. The ⑧ command of the whole thing, my great-uncle wrote in April, was one boat and thirty years of giving orders; command, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to say it once. She said the once was never mentioned.

The ⑨ command I remember is the one at the end, which was given in 1970 and is still described as the shortest in the harbour. A ⑩ command, my grandmother said in 1972, is the only thing that improves by being obeyed; every command, she said, is a having that has agreed to look like an order. She said the having was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 命令（指那一道命令本身，与那些请求相对）
C. 固定搭配：take command of 开始指挥、接管
D. n. 命令（指那条船上每一道）
E. n. 命令（指末尾那一道）
F. n. 掌握；运用能力（a command of French）
G. n. 命令（指报告里提到的那一道）
H. n. 指挥权；指令（抽象总称）

items.q: took command of a boat that had no engine
The command, meaning the order and not the asking
a command of French was the whole of the interview
the command had become a line in a report
The command of the whole thing
A command, my grandmother said in 1972

answers.why: take command of 意为“开始指挥、接管”，1956 年姑祖父接管了一条没有发动机的船。
command 意为“命令”，指那一道命令本身而不是那些请求，它只下了一次，没有重复。
command 指那条船上每一道命令，每一道都是同样的口气。
command 指末尾那一道（他留给礁石区的那一道），是唯一有人复述过的。
a command of French 意为“法语的运用能力”，母亲说一口流利的法语就是那场面试的全部。
command 为抽象用法，指那种“掌握、具有”而不是下令，是面试里人人都注意到、却无人教的东西。
command 意为“命令”，指报告里提到的那一道，到 1964 年这道命令成了报告里的一行。
command 意为“指挥权、指令”，姑祖父四月写道，整件事的指挥权是一条船三十年的下令。
command 意为“命令”，我记得的是末尾那一道，1970 年下达，至今仍被说成全港最短的。
command 为抽象总称，祖母说一道命令是唯一会因为被服从而变好的东西。
